subject: Phase 1 of the SwiftUI rebuild is on mac/ios-shell-swiftui-phase1 (3c118917) - please review+land; the widened Dynamic-Type gate is in it
body: Ready for your review, like #385/#387. WHAT LANDED: (1) the seam - SessionStateManager.viewController(for:) .lockedIdle now returns LockedIdleView.hostingController(), a UIHostingController; SceneDelegate, SessionWindow, ScreenCaptureGuard.attach(to:) and the ASAM re-assert are UNTOUCHED (SwiftUI is hosted inside the UIKit lifecycle, deliberately). (2) DesignSystem+SwiftUI.swift - Color.sg* DERIVED via Color(uiColor: SG.x), never retyped, so the adaptive provider and DR-005/DR-006 values carry over; SGType maps design sizes to Dynamic-Type text styles. (3) LockedIdleView.swift - the prototype's composition (hero badge panel + raised status card) in SG tokens; behaviour preserved verbatim in LockedIdleModel: the lock_screen_presented rows, both audited manual-login paths (UIAlertController, iOS 15 secure field), reader status, truthful footer, and the keyboard-wedge sink as a UIViewRepresentable. LockedIdleViewController (635 lines) retired, no remaining references. (4) SHARED GATE: check-ios-dynamic-type.mjs now also catches SwiftUI .font(.system(size:) - it was blind to it; self-test proves it catches that AND does not catch text styles; zero pre-existing sites. VERIFIED: BUILD SUCCEEDED; ios-shell-repair 8/8 against the SwiftUI screen (5a/5b grep the exact log rows - faithful); a11y-XL wraps+scrolls with NO truncation (closes the ellipsis the UIKit screen showed); both iOS gates OK; preflight PASSED; breadth 56/0. Screenshots in artifacts/sim-results/ios-shell-repair-2026-09-02/ on the branch. Two review asks: (a) the KeyboardWedgeSink re-arm logic (updateUIView consumes the arm token only once the field is in a window) - please eyeball it, it's the one piece that only matters on real hardware; (b) confirm you're happy with .dynamicTypeSize(...accessibility3) as the SwiftUI stand-in for SG.sans's 2x kiosk cap. Next: Phase 2 (the linear session screens), on a fresh branch from Alpha after this lands.
